text:
Alice K: Pushed a PR that adds preflight linting for routing YAML in the Console. The linter finds header-override precedence issues but the UI doesn't show how to fix them.
Ben L: repro'd locally. When a route has both `headers` and `overrides` the precedence isn't clear. example:
```
route: /search
headers:
  X-Region: us-east
overrides:
  header.X-Region: eu-west
```
This makes `X-Region` ambiguous.
Carmen R: we need the Console to surface a suggestion — eg 'Move header override into explicit match' or show which wins. Quick-fix button would be ideal.
Alice K: Agreed. Current linter outputs are just `WARN header-precedence ambiguous` with no hint. See CI output:
```
[devex-lint] routes.yaml:12: WARN header-precedence ambiguous (headers vs overrides)
```
Devex Bot: @alice_k devex-lint failed on branch route-authoring. See https://ci/reports/123
Ben L: UX proposal: when ambiguity detected, show a diff preview and an "Apply suggested change" that edits the YAML in the editor. Minimal suggestion: convert `overrides` to `match.headers` or vice versa.
Carmen R: Also add a unit test in `routing-schema-tests` that checks the linter suggests the canonical transformation. We can add a golden file.
Alice K: Implementation note: the linter currently runs in the backend using `ajv` schema validation + custom rules in `lint/rules`. Quick-fix generator would be an extra step that emits a `suggestion` object.
Ben L: We should add an API in the Console: POST /lint/suggest with payload `{route: <yaml>, rule: header-precedence}` -> responds with patch. Keep it idempotent.
infra-bot: CI note: if we add auto-apply, require an opt-in toggle in Console and a flag `--allow-quick-fix` in the lint CI to avoid surprise changes.
Alice K: I'll draft the Console mockup and an RFC for the lint API. Assigning to @ben to prototype the suggestion generator. :thumbsup: 
Ben L: I'll do a spike tomorrow. If we can produce a JSON Patch like `[{\"op\":\"replace\",\"path\":\"/overrides/header.X-Region\",\"value\":null}, {\"op\":\"add\",\"path\":\"/match/headers/X-Region\",\"value\":\"eu-west\"}]` then the Console can apply it.
Carmen R: tiny UX ask: when a suggestion is applied, record the change into the change history and attach the linter rule id. Helps audits.
Devex Bot: Reminder: add an entry to `devex/CHANGELOG.md` when the feature lands.
Alice K: cool, thanks everyone. I'll open the RFC doc and link it here.
